outcome: Specific diagnoses leading to near miss
cohort: Women admitted to the obstetric intensive care unit of a tertiary hospital in Recife (Brazil) over a period of four years.
finding: Hypertensive disorders, particularly HELLP syndrome, were the most common diagnoses among maternal near miss cases, highlighting the importance of recognizing and managing these conditions.
mod_finding: This study does not examine mode of delivery, focusing instead on characterizing maternal near miss cases.
